prompt: IMPORTANT: plain live television look. No sparks, no fire, no explosions, no glowing or flashing effects, no cartoon effects of any kind. Nobody wears boxing gloves or MMA gloves - bare knuckles with thin hand wraps only, and the cat's paws are bare fur, never gloved. Continuous single shot, no cuts, camera completely LOCKED on a tripod, only a tiny handheld tremble; it does NOT zoom, push in, orbit or travel. Bare-knuckle boxing ring. The ginger tabby cat is ENORMOUS - a head and a half taller than the human fighter, towering over her, and it stays that size in every frame. The small fighter looks up at it, throws nothing, keeps her guard high and backs away. The huge cat reaches down and taps her once with an open paw, almost gently, and she is knocked off her feet and sits down hard on the canvas, looking up in disbelief. The cat calmly licks its paw. The size difference is the whole joke - keep the cat clearly much taller than the human at all times. She NEVER throws a punch and never touches the cat. Shot on a long telephoto lens with very shallow depth of field: only the fighters and the ring ropes are sharp, the crowd and every banner behind the ring stay completely out of focus, no letters or logos legible behind the ring at any moment. The ring stays exactly as in the first frame: same corner pads, ropes, canvas and on-screen graphics bar. Do not invent or re-spell any text, no gibberish, no logos of any other fight promotion. Real speed, natural motion blur, correct anatomy, no morphing paws. Photorealistic. No blood, no injury, comedic tone. Audio: roaring arena crowd, one light slap as the paw taps her, a thud as she sits down, then the crowd bursts out laughing and roaring. No music, no commentary, no speech.
